name.value: South Surrey Recreation and Arts Centre

description.value: South Surrey Recreation and Arts Centre is a City of Surrey municipal facility offering a spacious weight room, three gymnasiums for sport programs, a designated pottery studio, and childminding services. It serves as a broad community hub for recreation and arts in the South Surrey area. Touring cyclists may find it a convenient urban stop, though it is oriented primarily toward local community use rather than tourism.
